decision: Kew POWO accepts subspecies rank and explicitly lists the flora's varietal name as synonym; historical variety morphological data retained with its original name and source page 640
alternative_classification: ITIS accepts rank variety rather than subspecies; this is rank difference within the mapped taxon, not evidence of a different field diagnosis
scope_warning: Do not assign species-level flower and pod dimensions as distinctive subspecies-level characters
preservation: Additive-only research; no photo or species changes
